name: shine-docs
description: Skill set that turns documents and code changes into highly readable outputs: document-refactor (document restructuring to HTML/Markdown) and explain-diff-html (interactive HTML explanation of a diff/PR).

interface.shortDescription: Restructure documents and explain diffs as readable HTML/Markdown
interface.longDescription: Use Shine Docs to restructure arbitrary documents (specs, experiment reports, meeting minutes, PR descriptions) into type-appropriate logical structures with a factuality-gated review loop, and to produce rich interactive HTML explanations of code changes (background, intuition, walkthrough, quiz).
defaultPrompt: Restructure this document into a readable format.
Explain this diff as an interactive HTML page.
